navigation.match: y. Yes, I trust this folder

ready: Press up to edit queued messages

operationalEvidence.source: Installed Claude Code 2.1.308 --help/--version and own isolated tmux probes (tmux -L, 2026-10-22); runner-protocol-evidence.md, розділ «Claude Code 2.1.308: протокол raf».
operationalEvidence.invocationReason: Interactive TUI in screen-reader mode; dontAsk never shows tool prompts (anything not allowed is denied); Bash/Read/Glob/Grep allowed, edits only by per-launch Edit(/<dir>/**) rules matching --add-dir grants; Bash confined by the native sandbox with failIfUnavailable and no unsandboxed escape; no --dangerously-skip-permissions; native ID assigned by --session-id and confirmed on /status before the brief.
operationalEvidence.budgetReason: Owned no-model probes: ready 3264 and 3292 ms in a trusted git root; /status panel showed the assigned Session ID; bracketed paste of 61 lines showed '[Pasted text #1 +60 lines]'; /exit closed the pane with status 0. Startup and transition 10 s, overall 30 s, poll 100 ms as for codex.
operationalEvidence.nativeIdentity: Assigned UUID passed by --session-id equals the Session ID line of /status before any brief.
operationalEvidence.hostPrerequisite: Native sandbox needs bubblewrap and socat; on this host socat is missing, so with failIfUnavailable the CLI exits 1 before readiness.
operationalEvidence.startupScreen: Owned no-model tmux probes 2026-10-22 (claude 2.1.308, 130x45, poll 50 ms): empty pane at 0 ms, only '[Screen Reader Mode: on via flag]' from about 170-226 ms until about 3.2 s, then the ready screen in a trusted git root or the workspace trust prompt below the same line in an untrusted one; /exit closed the pane with status 0. The trust prompt was not answered.
operationalEvidence.deliveryScreen: Own tmux -L probes 2026-10-22 (claude 2.1.308, default 80x24, poll 50 ms, sonnet/low, one-word answer, briefs of 30/30/119 lines): load-buffer + paste-buffer -p + Enter shows '$', NBSP, space, '[Pasted text #1 +N lines]' for about 110-130 ms with 'paste again to expand' in place of the ready mode line; then a spinner verb line ('Germinating…', 'Garnishing…', 'Pouncing…'; QA run 'Slithering…') above 'Tip: …', the paste hint and an empty '$' for 2-6 s, never 'esc to interrupt'; then '<Verb> for Ns · done HH:MM PM', and the ready mode line returns about 8 s after the paste. Enter right after the paste submitted it in all three probes. tmux kill-session left the claude process alive about 750 ms.
